description: PADDING CHARACTER clause (file control entry) - the ANSI X3.23-1985 Sequential I-O block-fill character (PADDING [CHARACTER] IS {data-name-1 | literal-1}); no program-visible effect in a model with no blocking, so parsed-and-ignored at 85/2002 (the MULTIPLE FILE / RERUN posture), with the obsolete-element warning COBOL0903 at 2002. THE EDGES ARE QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:VII.2.7.4 GR1 has it ('The PADDING CHARACTER clause specifies the character which is to be used for block padding on sequential files'); §2002:12.3.4.10 keeps it and marks it obsolete: 'The PADDING CHARACTER clause is an obsolete element in this International Standard and is to be deleted from the next revision of standard COBOL' (§2002:G.2 item 3: 'The PADDING CHARACTER clause has never been well-defined, and the action it takes is more appropriate to an external specification. There were no known implementations that treat it as other than a comment.'); §2014:E.2 item 19 removes it: 'The following features that were classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard, have been removed from this International Standard: - Communication facility - Debugging lines and the DEBUGGING MODE phrase - PADDING CHARACTER clause'. The 2014 file control entry's clauses are §2014:12.4.4.4 through §2014:12.4.4.14 and none is PADDING; its external-connector list drops the 2002 item (§2002:12.3.4.3 GR1h 'The same specification of the PADDING CHARACTER clause' is §2014:12.4.4.3 GR1h 'The same specification of the RELATIVE KEY clause'). It stays DELETED at 2023: the file control entry's clauses are 12.4.5.4 through 12.4.5.15 and none is PADDING, and the word appears NOWHERE in the 2023 text, 8.9 included. GnuCOBOL 3.2 agrees (padding-character-clause obsolete in cobol2002.conf, unconformable in cobol2014.conf; kb/Work PB656), and its word lists keep PADDING reserved at 2002 and not at 2014 (reserved-words.json), so the clause and the user-word-padding-2014 row agree. kb/Work PB300, PB656.
display: the PADDING CHARACTER clause (file control entry)
citation: §1985:VII.2.7.4 GR1; §2002:12.3.4.10; §2002:G.2 item 3; §2002:12.3.4.3 GR1h; §2014:E.2 item 19; §2014:12.4.4.3 GR1h; absent from the whole ISO 2023 text (the file control entry's clauses are §2023:12.4.5.4-§2023:12.4.5.15, none PADDING; §2023:8.9's list runs PACKED-DECIMAL -> PAGE); VCR Table 7 row 7.20
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.20; reserved-words.json row PADDING (r2014/r2023 false)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMPADC.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmpadc" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
        PADDING CHARACTER IS SPACE.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "PAD" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
